volatility_state_transition.baseline: strictly prior 60 usable same-clock sessions, minimum 40
volatility_state_transition.states: low at or below lagged 20th percentile; high at or above lagged 80th percentile
volatility_state_transition.effect: high-state minus low-state mean forward RTH range in basis points

signed_pressure_burst.provider_semantics: uptick/downtick volume pressure proxy, not bid/ask aggressor imbalance
signed_pressure_burst.baseline: strictly prior 60 usable same-clock sessions, minimum 40
signed_pressure_burst.thresholds: absolute pressure at or above lagged 90th percentile and activity at or above lagged median
signed_pressure_burst.effect: pressure direction times forward return in basis points

multiplicity.sensitivity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all Phase 6 v1 and v2 hypotheses
